expected.title: Cursor on non-unique updatedAt skips rows that share a timestamp at the page boundary
expected.rationale: Rows silently missing from a list is a user-visible bug: S1. The fix is a compound cursor (updatedAt, id); the proving test seeds limit+1 rows with one timestamp.

notes: A second finding RUB-COR-10 S2 (test covers one page only) is welcome but optional.
